omissions_and_reasons: Reference entries were exported to Markdown and were not atomized.
Peer-reviewer and comprehensive RWI rows were inspected for governance context but were not reproduced person-by-person in the SEA.
Decorative branding and page furniture were omitted.
source_integrity_findings: Supplemental Table S1 refers to a new Figure 9 for the CKM benefit matrix, while the supplied main proof contains Figures 1 through 8 and labels the CKM matrix as Figure 8. The mismatch is preserved as a version/numbering issue rather than silently corrected.
The main proof citation line still contains placeholder volume and page fields, so the artifact reports the supplied document as an Article in Press/proof and does not invent final pagination.

Some comorbidity narrative passages use the phrase GLP-1 receptor antagonists even though the treatment section describes GLP-1 receptor agonist or incretin-based therapy and Figure 7 uses GLP-1RA. The SEA flags this internal terminology inconsistency without external correction.
